content: Our model outperformance is persistent across sectors, i.e. the characteristics of the results reported in tbl:garchallsectors permeates all sectors, rather than being composed of a mix of outperforming and underperforming sector contributions. This fact provides a strong evidence that our model is more accurate than GARCH(1,1).
